name: Dvalloc
description:
About This Game



You are Dvalloc, a dwarf living in an underground village.
One day, the dwarven miners dig too deep and uncover a cursed rune...
Apart from nearly destroying the village, it corrupts everyone there. As you're the only one who survived, it becomes your mission to save the dwarves and rebuild your village.

Search for the corrupted dwarves in deep caverns beneath your home. Mine gems, crystals and other resources to bring them back to the village and restore it to its former glory!



  • Explore a vast, underground world divided into various areas.
  • Fight a diverse cast of enemies using different dwarven weapons.
  • Defeat powerful bosses to free them from the corruption.
  • Manage your health by assigning heart crystals with unique abilities.
  • Rescue your dwarven friends to speak to them and purchase items or upgrades.
  • Rebuild the village one building at a time.
  • Acquire new movement abilities such as double jump, dash and wall jump!



  • Satisfying, responsive movement
  • Beautiful pixelart graphics
  • 4 vastly different areas to explore
  • More than 10 types of enemies
  • 9+ dangerous bosses
  • 4 different weapons
  • An engaging story of a dwarven village
short_desc: Become Dvalloc The Dwarf and save your village from cursed rune's corruption! Explore an underground world, battle dangerous enemies, save your dwarven friends and acquire new weapons and abilites, all while admiring stunning pixelart visuals!
